title: Visited cells of the virtual input head
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean-input multi-tape Turing machine with $m$ work tapes, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $y$. Suppose the Boolean tag $b$ marks the boundary of the input-head position of $c$: at position $0$ it is false, and at position $|y|+1$ it is true. For any Boolean word $x$, input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ positions, output prefix, and time $t$, the cells visited by the virtual-host machine's buffer-tape head through time $t$ are exactly the integers obtained by subtracting $1$ from the input-head position of $M$ at each time $u=0,1,\ldots,t$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean tag $b$ satisfying the two boundary implications for $c$'s input-head position
